title: Express Niagara Falls with Boat, Journey Behind Falls, and Skylon
blurb: Explore the highlights of Niagara Falls, Canada in just 3 hours on this small-group express tour. Gain priority access to key attractions such as Journey Behind the Falls, where you'll stand close to the thundering Horseshoe Falls. Ascend to the Skylon Tower for stunning panoramic views of the falls and the surrounding landscape. Seasonally, enjoy a boat ride with Niagara City Cruises to feel the power of the falls up close, or immersive Niagara Takes Flight experience during winter. Perfect for travelers seeking a quick yet unforgettable adventure.
